reviewer: A reviewer who has not seen the code

reasons.phone: The two balcony slabs fill the top half of the shot; below, a blank board with a phone outline and a dark shop with goods. Named a building with a phone shop on a second look; the boards are blank in every render.
reasons.silhouette: The front says shops under flats; the back is a dark wall with three barred windows, one side shows the stair, the other is blank with two balcony ends: two of four.
reasons.proportion: Storeys, balconies, the side stair and the person agree.
reasons.palette: Palette only, but the grey-mint wall and the brown balcony slabs are close in value and the back and sides are a flat dark grey-green: flat against the street.
reasons.wear: Tanks, AC units, a generator, wires, crates and goods at the doors, burglar bars at the back.
reasons.variety: Near a copy of bld_market-block (same layout, stair, tanks and generator) and the same wall colour as bld_bode-thomas-betting.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 1,244 of 1,500 (82%), draw calls 1 of 1 (100%), materials 1 of 1 (100%), bytes 13,432 of 40,000 (33%). Inside every figure, over 80% on at least one.

notes: Boards blank in the renders; the place shots show words on the Computer Village boards, which the piece's own renders should too. A kit piece: no outline is scored.
